name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the given context and fact. A highly relevant response directly addresses the conversation and the provided fact.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how well the response encourages further conversation. A highly engaging response invites the other party to continue the dialogue.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and uniqueness of the response. A creative response adds new and interesting elements to the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical flow and consistency of the response. A coherent response maintains a clear and logical sequence of ideas.

name: Empathy
description: Evaluates the degree to which the response shows understanding and consideration for the other party's feelings and perspectives. An empathetic response demonstrates emotional intelligence.
